findings.issue: הַמִּשְׁכָּן is a common noun (article + masculine singular), left as the untranslated lemma mishkán instead of Spanish.
Hiphil active participle is a bare gerund, so the relative clause has no finite predicate; the showing concept is still present.

notes: 2mp תַּעֲשׂוּ as harán is ustedes address; כֵּלָיו plural with a 3ms suffix matches sus utensilios.
